title: Recurring schedule
description: A recurring meeting schedule for a course instance or event.

scheduleTimezone.description: An IANA time-zone identifier, for example Europe/Berlin.

repeatFrequency.description: The ISO 8601 interval between occurrences, for example P1W.

startDate.description: The first calendar date on which an occurrence may take place.

endDate.description: The last calendar date on which an occurrence may take place, inclusive.
